date.description: The time to draw, an ISO 8601 string in UTC (for example 2026-01-01T09:30:00Z), which the page binds to the current time. The clock does not tick by itself; empty draws NaN.

showDate.description: If true, displays the date (day and abbreviated month) after the time. Defaults to false.

showTimezone.description: If true, displays the timezone after the time. Defaults to false.

timeZoneOffsetHours.description: Timezone offset in hours, from UTC. Defaults to 0.

activated.description: If true, the clock as a button is activated. For example, when the calendar is open, the clock is activated.

blinkOnlyBreakpointPx.description: The pixel width at which the component switches to blink-only mode. When the viewport width is less than or equal to this value, only the blinking colon is shown. Defaults to 0 (never switches to blink-only).

isClickable.description: Whether the clock is a button (draws its pressed and hover states). False draws a plain block.

componentSize.description: Component size: regular, medium, large or xl.
